info.name: Developer Assessment & Coding Platform API
info.description:
Complete collection for the Developer Assessment & Coding Platform. Covers Auth, Users, Candidates, Recruiters, Admins, Assessments, Problems, Invitations, Attempts, Answers, Results and Payments.

## Environment Variables
- `baseUrl` : API base URL, e.g. `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`
- `recruiterToken` : Bearer token of a logged-in RECRUITER
- `candidateToken` : Bearer token of a logged-in CANDIDATE
- `adminToken` : Bearer token of a logged-in ADMIN

## Authentication
Only public endpoints are the Root, Auth register/verify/login, Google OAuth, payment callback, forgot/reset password. All other endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header (token can also be passed via httpOnly cookie). Login as each role first, then copy the returned `accessToken` into the corresponding environment variable.

## Demo API IDs
Some endpoints take dynamic IDs (assessmentId, problemId, attemptId, etc.). These are returned by previous API calls at runtime. Placeholder values are provided and should be replaced with real UUIDs from your database.

request.description: Returns health status of the running server.
Register a new RECRUITER account. An OTP is sent to the email (stored in Redis). Note: password must contain at least 1 lowercase, 1 uppercase, 1 number, and 1 special character, min 8 chars.
Register a new CANDIDATE account. An OTP is sent to the email (stored in Redis). Note: password must contain at least 1 lowercase, 1 uppercase, 1 number, and 1 special character, min 8 chars.

Verify the 6-digit OTP sent to the user's email. On success, the user is created and `accessToken` + `refreshToken` (and `user`) are returned in response body. Copy the `accessToken` into `recruiterToken` / `candidateToken` env var. The OTP is also set as an httpOnly cookie. Use the OTP value received in the email (demo: 123456).

Login as RECRUITER. For CANDIDATE, change email to `candidate.demo@gmail.com`. Returns `{ accessToken, refreshToken }` in body and also sets httpOnly cookies. Use the returned `accessToken` as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` for protected endpoints.
Initiate Google OAuth2 authentication flow. Redirects to Google's consent screen.

query.description: Google OAuth authorization code returned after consent

request.description: Handled automatically by Google OAuth redirect flow. Uses `GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL` from env. On success user is redirected to `{{frontendUrl}}/auth/success`.
Clears the httpOnly accessToken and refreshToken cookies. Public endpoint.
Send a 6-digit reset OTP to the user's email. OTP is stored in Redis for 5 minutes.
Reset password using the OTP sent to the email. newPassword must meet the same strong password policy (min 8, lowercase, uppercase, number, special).
Get the currently authenticated user's details including role-specific profile (candidate or recruiter). Requires ADMIN, CANDIDATE or RECRUITER token.

formdata.description: Profile image file (max 5MB). Uploaded to Cloudinary.

request.description: Upload a profile image for the logged-in user. Multipart/form-data with a single file field `profileImage` (max 5MB). Requires any authenticated role.

request.description: Update the logged-in recruiter's profile. Multipart/form-data. The `data` field must be a JSON string; the `companyLogo` field is an optional file upload. Requires RECRUITER token.

Get aggregate dashboard statistics for the logged-in recruiter: total assessments, published assessments, total candidates, total attempts, pending evaluations, and average score. Requires RECRUITER token.

Get detailed statistics for a single assessment: total candidates invited, total/completed attempts, pending evaluations, passed/failed counts, and average score. Requires RECRUITER token. Replace `{{assessmentId}}` with the actual assessment ID.
Update the logged-in admin's name. Requires ADMIN token.

query.description: Filter by status: ACTIVE | SUSPENDED | DELETED

request.description: List all candidates and recruiters with pagination, search, role and status filters. Admin can see all users; candidate/recruiter profiles are included. Requires ADMIN token.
Update a user's status to ACTIVE or SUSPENDED (DELETED cannot be reactivated). Creates an audit log entry. Replace `{{userId}}` with the target user's ID. Requires ADMIN token.

query.description: Search by entityId, user name or email
Filter by action: CREATE | UPDATE | DELETE | PUBLISH | INVITE | SUBMIT | EVALUATE | SUSPEND | ACTIVATE | PAYMENT_COMPLETED
Filter by entity: USER | ASSESSMENT | PROBLEM | INVITATION | ATTEMPT | SUBMISSION | PAYMENT | ANSWER

request.description: List audit logs with pagination, search, action and entity filters. Each log includes the triggering user. Requires ADMIN token.

request.description: Create a new assessment (status defaults to DRAFT). `duration` is in minutes. `startAt`/`endAt` are ISO 8601 datetimes; end must be after start. Requires RECRUITER token. Note: startAt must be in the future.

query.description: Filter by status: DRAFT | PUBLISHED | ONGOING | COMPLETED | ARCHIVED

request.description: List assessments created by the logged-in recruiter with pagination, search and status filter. Requires RECRUITER token.
List assessments. For a RECRUITER, returns only their own assessments; for an ADMIN, returns all assessments. Requires RECRUITER or ADMIN token.

Get a single assessment including its problems (ordered by questionOrder). Recruiters can only view their own; admins can view any. Requires RECRUITER or ADMIN token. Replace `{{assessmentId}}` with the assessment ID.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Frontend Developer Assessment - Round 1 (Updated)",
  "description": "Revised description with additional focus on accessibility and testing.",
  "duration": 75,
  "totalMarks": 100,
  "passingMarks": 65
}

request.description: Update an assessment's details. Cannot be updated while ONGOING or COMPLETED. Passing marks cannot exceed total marks; end must be after start. Requires RECRUITER token (owner only). Replace `{{assessmentId}}`.

Publish a DRAFT assessment (transitions to PUBLISHED). The assessment must have at least one problem AND a COMPLETED payment. Creates an audit log. Requires RECRUITER token (owner). Replace `{{assessmentId}}`.
Soft-delete an assessment (sets deletedAt). Cannot be deleted while ONGOING or COMPLETED. Requires RECRUITER (owner) or ADMIN token. Replace `{{assessmentId}}`.

Add an existing problem to an assessment. `problemId` must be a UUID of a problem owned by the same recruiter. Question order is auto-assigned. Cannot be added to ONGOING/COMPLETED assessments. Requires RECRUITER token. Replace `{{assessmentId}}` and `{{problemId}}`.
List problems attached to an assessment, ordered by questionOrder. Requires RECRUITER token (owner). Replace `{{assessmentId}}`.
Remove a problem from an assessment. Remaining problems are re-ordered automatically. Cannot be done on ONGOING/COMPLETED assessments. Requires RECRUITER token (owner). Replace IDs.
Reorder problems within an assessment. ALL problems in the assessment must be included. `questionOrder` must be unique and sequential starting from 1. Requires RECRUITER token (owner). Replace IDs.
List PUBLISHED assessments for which the candidate has a PENDING invitation. Includes invitation details. Requires CANDIDATE token.

request.description: Create a coding problem. No options or correctAnswer allowed. Requires RECRUITER token.

query.description: Filter by type: MCQ | WRITTEN | CODING
Filter by difficulty: EASY | MEDIUM | HARD

request.description: List problems created by the logged-in recruiter with pagination, search, type and difficulty filters. Requires RECRUITER token.
List problems. For a RECRUITER, returns only their own problems; for an ADMIN, returns all problems. Requires RECRUITER or ADMIN token.
Get a single problem. `correctAnswer` is only returned to the owning recruiter. Requires RECRUITER or ADMIN token. Replace `{{problemId}}`.

request.description: Update a problem (partial updates supported). Follows same validation rules as creation (MCQ requires options & valid correctAnswer; non-MCQ must have neither). Requires RECRUITER token (owner). Replace `{{problemId}}`.
Soft-delete a problem (sets deletedAt). Cannot be deleted if it is attached to any assessment. Requires RECRUITER (owner) or ADMIN token. Replace `{{problemId}}`.

Invite a CANDIDATE to an assessment. The assessment must be PUBLISHED (or ONGOING), not DRAFT/COMPLETED/ARCHIVED. `candidateId` is the candidate's USER id. `expiresAt` cannot be after assessment endAt. Sends an invitation email. Requires RECRUITER token (owner). Replace IDs.

query.description: Search by candidate name/email or assessment title
Filter by status: PENDING | ACCEPTED | DECLINED | EXPIRED

request.description: List invitations sent by the logged-in recruiter with candidate & assessment info. Requires RECRUITER token.

query.description: Filter by status: PENDING | ACCEPTED | DECLINED | EXPIRED

request.description: List invitations received by the logged-in candidate with assessment info. Requires CANDIDATE token.
Accept or decline an invitation. Only possible while status is PENDING and the assessment is PUBLISHED/ONGOING and not expired. Requires CANDIDATE token. Replace `{{invitationId}}`.

Initiates a bKash payment for publishing an assessment. The assessment must belong to the recruiter and be not yet paid. Returns a `paymentUrl` where the recruiter completes bKash payment. Requires RECRUITER token. Replace `{{assessmentId}}`.
Re-initiates a bKash payment for an assessment whose previous payment is PENDING (not completed). Returns a fresh `paymentUrl`. Requires RECRUITER token. Replace `{{assessmentId}}`.

query.description: bKash payment ID from the tokenized checkout

request.description: bKash callback endpoint. Handles success/cancel/failure, executes the payment, and redirects the recruiter to the frontend with the payment status in the URL. Public endpoint (called by bKash).

Start an assessment attempt as a candidate. Requires the assessment to be ONGOING, clause end time & candidate to have an ACCEPTED invitation. One attempt per candidate per assessment. Returns attempt + assessment details. Requires CANDIDATE token. Replace `{{assessmentId}}`.
Get details of one of the logged-in candidate's attempts, including answer count and assessment info. Requires CANDIDATE token. Replace `{{attemptId}}`.
Get questions for an in-progress attempt, ordered by questionOrder. Only available while attempt is IN_PROGRESS. Requires CANDIDATE token. Replace `{{attemptId}}`.

Submit/save an answer for a problem in the current attempt (upserts by attempt+problem). For MCQ problems, the answer must match one of the options. Auto-submits attempt if time has expired. Requires CANDIDATE token. Replace `{{attemptId}}` and `{{problemId}}`.

Manually submit an in-progress attempt. If the assessment has only MCQ (no subjective) problems, the result is computed and set to READY. Otherwise the result stays PROCESSING until all subjective answers are evaluated. Requires CANDIDATE token. Replace `{{attemptId}}`.

query.description: Search by problem title, candidate name/email, or assessment title

request.description: List pending (un-evaluated) WRITTEN/CODING answers across the recruiter's assessments, with problem, candidate and attempt details. Requires RECRUITER token.

Get a single answer with its problem, attached attempt, candidate, assessment, and any existing evaluation. Only for submitted attempts in the recruiter's assessments. Requires RECRUITER token. Replace `{{answerId}}`.

Evaluate a WRITTEN or CODING answer. `score` must be 0 or greater and cannot exceed the problem's marks. `feedback` is optional (max 1000 chars). When all subjective answers for the attempt are evaluated, the result is finalized (READY) automatically. Requires RECRUITER token. Replace `{{answerId}}`.

query.description: Filter by result status: PROCESSING | READY

request.description: List the logged-in candidate's assessment results with pagination, search and status filter. Requires CANDIDATE token.
Get the result for a specific submitted attempt. The attempt must be owned by the candidate and SUBMITTED. Requires CANDIDATE token. Replace `{{attemptId}}`.
Get all results for a specific assessment owned by the recruiter, including candidate info. Requires RECRUITER token. Replace `{{assessmentId}}`.
Get a single result by ID, accessible by the recruiter who owns the assessment, with full attempt, candidate and assessment details. Requires RECRUITER token. Replace `{{resultId}}`.
